notes: Cross-verse split: `וְעַתָּה` is divided one way here and the other way in v. 10, with nothing in the source to license the difference. The verse gave *Now* to the waw and *therefore* to `עַתָּה`; v. 10, twice, gives the *now* to `עַתָּה` and the remaining connective to the waw. Swapped s001 and s002 so the adverb takes the word that writes its own lexeme. No other unit is touched.
